chapter.verse: Pasian aw, Zion-ah nangmah phat dingin kilawm hi; nangma tunga thuciamna sate hong kibawl ding hi.
Nangmah in thungetna a za-pa na hi hi! Mawhna thu hangin nangma kiangah mi khempeuh hong pai ding uh hi.
Ka mawhnate un kote hong zawh ciangin, nangmah in tuate nong maisak hi.
Na inn-a om dinga na tel na lakte in mi nuamsa ahi hi! Nangma biakinn siangtho ahi na inn sunga hoihna tawh lungkim nung!
Tuipi gamla pente leh leimong dong khempeuhte’ lametna, komau’ kihotkhiatna Pasian,
nangma thahatna tawh mualte a bawl, vangliatna tawh a kidim,
tuipi gingte, tuihual gingte, mi gamlumte a daisakpa aw,

lei mong pek-a omte in na hihsa limte a kihtak nadingun kihtakhuai gamtatna zangin, hotkhiatna tawh kote’ ngetna nong pia hi; nisuahna leh nitumna kikal-a om mite khempeuh lungdam-a awng dingin na bawl hi.
Nangmah in leitung en-in guah na zusak a, a hoihna lianpi-in na behlap hi; Pasian’ gunpi in tui tawh kidim hi; nangmah in amaute khaici na guan hi, tua ahih ciangin nangmah in na bawl khol hi.
Tu ma-kuakte tui tampi na buak a, leivumte zalh mai-in, guahtui tawh na nipsak a, a po kungte thupha na pia hi.
Nangma hauhna tawh kum na phasak a, na leng paina tengah sathau taak hi.
Ganhing tatna, a noptuak munte-ah ganhing hon omin mualte lungdamna tawh kidim a,
lo no-na munte tuuhon tawh kizem-in, kuampite an tawh kidim a, lungdamin awngin amaute in la sakhawm uh hi.
